data.name: Glass Lancet
data.description: She lifts one finger, and a sliver of the wall comes for you. Every lancet she throws steadies the next, and nothing can wash that steadiness from her hand; only time lets it go.
data.battleDescription: %user lifts one finger. A lancet of glass leaves the wall and finds %target.

data.name: The Glass Remembers
data.description: The hall is patient, but not forever. Linger too long in her house and every pane turns toward you at once, and there is no floor left that is not glass.

effects.description: The Glass Remembers: wave 1 of 4 (art only)
The Glass Remembers: wave 2 of 4 (art only)
The Glass Remembers: wave 3 of 4 (art only)
The Glass Remembers: wave 4 of 4 (art only)

data.battleDescription: Every pane in the hall turns toward you at once. The glass has remembered all of you.

data.name: Refraction
data.description: "Hold still. I want to see you in the light." Light runs in from the walls and lies across the floor, very bright and very still. Light like that does not stay whole for long.
data.battleDescription: "Hold still. I want to see you in the light." Light runs in from the walls.

data.name: Far Refraction
data.description: "Turn. I haven't seen this side of you." Light runs in from the far walls, laid across the floor where the first lines were not. It is just as bright, and just as brittle.
data.battleDescription: "Turn. I haven't seen this side of you." Light runs in from the far walls.

data.name: Facet
data.description: Once her glass is badly cracked, every line she draws has a reflection, mirrored across the hall. The gaps between a line and its double are narrow, and they are all there is.
data.battleDescription: "Every line has a reflection." The lines are drawn again, mirrored across the hall.

data.name: Refraction Breaks
data.description: The lines of light shatter where they lie, and whoever stood on one is cut deep. For a moment the broken glass stays sharp underfoot: wounds taken there close slowly and open wider.
data.battleDescription: The lines of light shatter where they lie.

data.name: Far Refraction Breaks
data.description: The far lines shatter where they lie. The shards stay sharp a moment longer than the light, and nothing standing in them mends well or bleeds little.
data.battleDescription: The far lines shatter where they lie.

data.name: Facet Breaks
data.description: The lines and their reflection shatter together. Where both images broke, the floor stays jagged for a moment, and nothing on it mends well.
data.battleDescription: Both images shatter at once.

data.name: Lucid Refraction
data.description: "I can see it clearly now." The lines shatter, and new ones are already lying where the light falls. She no longer needs to pause between one thought and the next.
data.battleDescription: The lines shatter, and new ones are already drawn. "I can see it clearly now."

data.name: Lucid
data.description: While her shadow stands beside her, she cannot hear herself think. Silence it, and Sayo hears every thought again, and her glass cuts deeper for it.
data.battleDescription: The hall is suddenly very loud. %user straightens. "I can hear myself again."

data.name: Your Own Strike
data.description: Your likeness strikes exactly the way you would, straight through the guard you trust. It has learned only your habits, and only for a little while.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes exactly the way you would.

data.name: The Hush
data.description: Where her shadow passes, sound stops and does not come back. The still pools it leaves stay a long time; whatever stands in them slowly empties, and no wound there will close.
data.battleDescription: Somewhere on the floor, sound stops. It does not come back.

data.name: The Hush, Unbridled
data.description: Nothing holds the quiet back now. It pours up through the floor faster than it ever did, and the pools it leaves wound whatever stands in them. Clean floor grows scarce.
data.battleDescription: Nothing holds the quiet back now. It pours up out of the floor in still, dark pools.

data.name: Stillness
data.description: The floor around the Silence goes still, and everything near her begins to stop. Nothing close to her moves for long. The far side of the hall is still loud.
data.battleDescription: The floor around the Silence goes still. Nothing there is moving, and soon nothing will.

data.name: Nothing Moves
data.description: For a moment nothing near the Silence moves, and nothing can. Those it holds are crushed, and for a few rounds after their wounds close slowly and open easily, until something clean washes the stillness off.
data.battleDescription: For a moment nothing near the Silence moves. Nothing can.

data.name: Cradle
data.description: The deep closes around her like cupped hands, and blows slide off the glass. It holds her only while something of the deep still lives in the hall, and nothing can pry the hold loose but that.
data.battleDescription: The deep closes around %target. Blows slide off the glass.

data.name: Grasp
data.description: The feeler closes around whatever is nearest, without a sound. What it holds cannot move for a moment and slowly empties, and the floor beneath a held thing does not wait for it.
data.battleDescription: %user closes around %target without a sound.

data.name: Etching: Rime
data.description: She traces the north of the hall into the glass. It rimes over, glows, and fades. The glass forgets nothing she draws.
data.battleDescription: %user traces the north of the hall into the glass. It rimes over, then fades.

data.name: Recast: Rime
data.description: The glass remembers the rime, and the north of the hall breaks with nothing to show where. Only someone who also remembers will be standing elsewhere. For a breath after the glass answers her, her own guard hangs open.
data.battleDescription: The glass remembers the rime, and the north of the hall breaks.

data.name: Etching: Ember
data.description: She traces the south of the hall into the glass. It glows like an ember, then fades from sight, but not from the glass.
data.battleDescription: %user traces the south of the hall into the glass. It glows like an ember, then fades.

data.name: Recast: Ember
data.description: The glass remembers the ember, and the south of the hall breaks without a mark. The ember was shown once, and once is all it gets. While the glass answers, she is open to anyone who stayed whole.
data.battleDescription: The glass remembers the ember, and the south of the hall breaks.

data.name: Etching: Seam
data.description: She traces a seam down the west wall. It glows, then sinks into the glass, which keeps it the way a scar keeps a cut.
data.battleDescription: %user traces a seam down the west wall. It glows, then fades.

data.name: Recast: Seam
data.description: The glass remembers the seam, and the west wall breaks, unmarked. The scar was always there for anyone who watched it sink in. Her guard stays open for a breath after the glass answers.
data.battleDescription: The glass remembers the seam, and the west wall breaks.

data.name: Etching: Heart
data.description: She traces the heart of the hall into the glass. It beats once, then fades. The glass keeps the rhythm long after the light is gone.
data.battleDescription: %user traces the heart of the hall into the glass. It beats once, then fades.

data.name: Recast: Heart
data.description: The glass remembers the heart, and the middle of the hall breaks, unmarked. The edges that never glowed are the only ones it does not remember. For a breath afterward her own guard hangs open.
data.battleDescription: The glass remembers the heart, and the middle of the hall breaks.

data.name: Etching: Hail
data.description: She taps a scatter of points into the glass, like hail. Each one glows and fades, and each one is remembered, exactly where it fell.
data.battleDescription: %user taps a scatter of points into the glass, like hail. They glow, then fade.

data.name: Recast: Hail
data.description: The glass remembers every point of hail, and all of them break at once, unmarked. Between the points it remembers there is room to stand. In the moment the glass answers, she stands open.
data.battleDescription: The glass remembers the hail, and every point breaks at once.

data.name: The Hush Rises
data.description: While she etches, the Silence seeps up through the floor in still patches that never close. More of them rise every time she draws, and whatever stands in one empties fast and cannot mend.
data.battleDescription: The floor stops making any sound in patches. The patches do not close.

items.name: The Glass Falls Quiet: custom art

data.name: The Glass Falls Quiet
data.description: "Again." She lowers her hand, and for a moment the hall rests. In the lull, someone worn steps out of the glass, and the next pattern is already waiting in her fingers.

effects.description: The Glass Falls Quiet: sound (art only)

data.battleDescription: %user lowers her hand. "Again." Something worn steps out of the glass.

data.name: Doorward Sweep
data.description: "Gate's closed." The gate porter sweeps the threshold clear with a heavy blow, and whoever stood there is put a step outside, onto whatever floor was behind them.
data.battleDescription: "Gate's closed." %user sweeps the threshold clear.

data.name: Worn Mending
data.description: "Hold still, it's nearly done." Sister Hana tends Sayo, closing her wounds a little at a time. She has done this for so long she no longer knows how to stop; someone will have to stop her.
data.battleDescription: "Hold still, it's nearly done." %user tends to %target.

data.name: Cadet's Tether
data.description: "Line's secure!" Tomo throws his line and hauls, and you come in several steps with it. The rope does not look down at the floor it pulls you over.
data.battleDescription: "Line's secure!" %user hauls %target in.

data.name: The Quiet
data.description: She closes her eyes and the hall goes quiet, and you go quiet with it. Each time, a little more of you stops mending and a little more gives way, and while her eyes are closed nothing can wash it off.
data.battleDescription: %user closes her eyes. The hall goes very quiet, and you go quiet with it.

data.name: Shatterfall
data.description: Cracks fan out from her feet across the glass. Glass that cracked like that will not hold anyone's weight for long, and no one standing in the fan has ever walked out of the fall.
data.battleDescription: Cracks fan out from %user's feet.

data.name: Shatterfall Gives Way
data.description: The fan of cracks gives way, and the glass beneath it falls. Those who were standing in it do not come back up, and the broken edges stay sharp underfoot for a while after.

effects.description: Shatterfall Gives Way: wave 1 of 5 (art only)
Shatterfall Gives Way: wave 2 of 5 (art only)
Shatterfall Gives Way: wave 3 of 5 (art only)
Shatterfall Gives Way: wave 4 of 5 (art only)
Shatterfall Gives Way: wave 5 of 5 (art only)

data.battleDescription: The fan of cracks gives way, and the glass beneath it falls.

items.name: Every Name in the Glass: custom art

data.name: Every Name in the Glass
data.description: "Do you hear them? Every one of them stayed." Every stilled name rises to the floor at once, and the whole hall glows with them, except three places: where the porter, the sister and the cadet refused to hold still.

effects.description: Every Name in the Glass: sound (art only)

data.battleDescription: "Do you hear them? Every one of them stayed." The names rise. Three places stay dry: where the three refused.

items.name: The Names Flood In: custom art

data.name: The Names Flood In
data.description: Every name in the glass floods the hall. They take everyone who stands among them; only the three who refused were never theirs, and the ground where they stood stays dry.

effects.description: The Names Flood In: wave 1 of 4 (art only)
The Names Flood In: wave 2 of 4 (art only)
The Names Flood In: wave 3 of 4 (art only)
The Names Flood In: wave 4 of 4 (art only)
The Names Flood In: sound (art only)

data.battleDescription: Every name in the glass floods the hall.

items.name: No One Is Mended: custom art

data.name: No One Is Mended
data.description: "Nothing mends here. Nothing needs to." While the names rise, the quiet covers the whole floor, and for a long time no wound anywhere will close. What you carried in is all you will have.

effects.description: No One Is Mended: sound (art only)

data.battleDescription: "Nothing mends here. Nothing needs to." The quiet covers the whole floor.

data.name: The Held Breath
data.description: She breathes in, and the air leaves the hall, except where the three refused. Something that large will have to be breathed out again, and everyone it reaches will go with it.
data.battleDescription: %user breathes in. The air leaves the hall, except where the three refused.

data.name: Breathless Pull
data.description: The breath she took is spent. Everyone it reaches is drawn toward her and left breathless, unable to move from wherever the breath set them down. The three dry places keep their air.
data.battleDescription: %user breathes out, and everyone she can reach comes with it, breathless.

items.name: Hush Where They Refused: custom art

data.name: Hush Where They Refused
data.description: The quiet finds one of the three dry places and seeps into it. That place is no longer dry; whoever waits there empties and cannot mend, and two places remain.

effects.description: Hush Where They Refused: sound (art only)

data.battleDescription: The quiet finds one of the dry places where the three refused.

data.name: The Long Hush
data.description: "Not yet. You are almost a good impression." When she is nearly broken, the hush holds her up and she will not fall, but no hush lasts. Above, the ceiling begins to come down.
data.battleDescription: "Not yet. You are almost a good impression." The ceiling begins to fall.

data.name: Glassfall: First Pane
data.description: A third of the ceiling comes down where the glass was marked, and the next pane cracks. The ceiling has three panes, and it falls one third at a time.

effects.description: Glassfall: First Pane: wave 1 of 3 (art only)
Glassfall: First Pane: wave 2 of 3 (art only)
Glassfall: First Pane: wave 3 of 3 (art only)

data.battleDescription: A third of the ceiling comes down, and the next pane cracks.

data.name: Glassfall: Second Pane
data.description: Another third of the ceiling comes down, and the next pane cracks. What was marked falls; what is newly marked will fall next.

effects.description: Glassfall: Second Pane: wave 1 of 3 (art only)
Glassfall: Second Pane: wave 2 of 3 (art only)
Glassfall: Second Pane: wave 3 of 3 (art only)

data.battleDescription: Another third of the ceiling comes down, and the next pane cracks.

data.name: Glassfall: Last Pane
data.description: The last third of the ceiling comes down, and the first pane cracks again. The fall goes round the hall the way a clock does.

effects.description: Glassfall: Last Pane: wave 1 of 3 (art only)
Glassfall: Last Pane: wave 2 of 3 (art only)
Glassfall: Last Pane: wave 3 of 3 (art only)

data.battleDescription: The last third of the ceiling comes down, and the first pane cracks again.

data.name: Glassfall: Opening Pane
data.description: This time the second third comes down first, and the last pane cracks. The ceiling keeps its marks honest even when it does not keep its order.

effects.description: Glassfall: Opening Pane: wave 1 of 3 (art only)
Glassfall: Opening Pane: wave 2 of 3 (art only)
Glassfall: Opening Pane: wave 3 of 3 (art only)

data.battleDescription: The second third of the ceiling comes down first, and the last pane cracks.

data.name: Glassfall: Heart Recast
data.description: The ceiling comes down, and the glass remembers the heart once more. Whoever learned where the heart was drawn in the Stilling remembers it too.

effects.description: Glassfall: Heart Recast: wave 1 of 3 (art only)
Glassfall: Heart Recast: wave 2 of 3 (art only)
Glassfall: Heart Recast: wave 3 of 3 (art only)

data.battleDescription: The ceiling comes down, and the glass remembers the heart once more.

data.name: The Silence Turns
data.description: Her shadow turns toward the weight of you. The floor under your feet goes still before it breaks, and it takes a great deal from whatever is still standing on it.
data.battleDescription: The floor under %target goes still. Something below has turned toward it.

data.name: The Glass Turns
data.description: In the lull, the glass remembers the weight of you. The floor where you stand goes still before it breaks, and it takes a great deal from whatever has not moved.
data.battleDescription: The glass under %target remembers the weight of you.

data.name: Your Likeness
data.description: "Hold still. There. That is you." When she is badly hurt, she pours an impression of you out of the glass. It fights the way you fight, but an impression is thin, and it does not last.
data.battleDescription: "Hold still. There. That is you." Your likeness steps out of the glass.

data.name: The Listening
data.description: Something under the floor turns toward the sound of you. A feeler of the deep rises and listens, and while any part of the deep still lives in the hall, it keeps hold of her.
data.battleDescription: Something under the floor turns toward the sound of you.

data.name: The Listening, Unbridled
data.description: It no longer waits to hear you. The feelers rise one after another now, and as long as one of them lives, the deep keeps its hold on her.
data.battleDescription: It no longer waits to hear you. Another feeler rises.

items.name: Raise the Gate Porter: custom art

data.name: Raise the Gate Porter
data.description: The gate porter steps out of the glass, thin as old paper, still holding the door he would not open on the night of the Stilling. He has never stood farther from her glass than this; she cannot let him. He keeps his threshold close and clears it of anyone who stands too near, wherever the step back lands them.
data.battleDescription: The gate porter steps out of the glass, still holding a door that is not there.

data.name: Raise Sister Hana
data.description: Sister Hana steps out of the glass, worn thin, hands already busy with someone else's wounds; she would not stop tending them when the hall went still. She comes no farther than Sayo can reach, and there she mends Sayo as she mended everyone. She will not stop on her own.
data.battleDescription: Sister Hana steps out of the glass, hands already busy with someone else's wounds.

data.name: Raise Cadet Tomo
data.description: Cadet Tomo steps out of the glass, faint at the edges, rope in hand; told to hold still that night, he ran, and the glass only half caught him. He can run no farther than her reach now. His line reaches a long way, and it does not care what floor it drags you across.
data.battleDescription: Cadet Tomo steps out of the glass, rope in hand, waiting for an order.

Drops: Skyglass Wreck clear 15%

Drops: Crownhold: every clear
Her invitation: carry all four shards (Keel, Crown, Tide and Ledger) to open the way to The Mother of Echoes. All four are spent when the fight begins. Shards trade.

data.description:
A splinter of the Mother Glass, left behind by what the Core cannot let go: the reliquary's echoes, and the night of the fall. A small thumbprint is pressed into it, made while the glass was soft.

Drops: The Sealed Reliquary, The Fall and both Legendary chart runs 75%

items.name: Shard of the Ledger: story line (RUL-2026-11-05-117)

data.description:
A splinter of the Mother Glass, entered in the stores ledger and never claimed. A small thumbprint is pressed into it, made while the glass was soft.

Drops: every Haul run 35%
Her invitation: carry all four shards (Keel, Crown, Tide and Ledger) to open the way to The Mother of Echoes. All four are spent when the fight begins. Shards trade.
A crystal-edged sword carried by the most faithful of the Captain's echoes. The command seals along its spine still answer him, turning a measure of every blow into a brief ward of glass.
A concentrated restorative sealed for the Ghost Ship's longest night watches. The medicine is still potent, though the crew it was brewed for has long since gone still.

items.name: Replicant Zero -> The First Impression (username only)

data.name: Crownhold
data.description:
The Lantern is spent when the expedition starts. Health carries from fight to fight, and a lost fight ends the expedition.
The shrines offer shortcuts, rites and riddles; every choice changes how you meet the Crowned Captain.

Carried out of the wreck, the Lastlight Lantern burns toward a mountain the maps call empty. Crownhold, the fortress that built the Skyglass Project and gave its crew their last order, has not answered a call in a generation. Its gates stand open. Nothing guards them.

Starting the expedition spends one Lastlight Lantern. Lose any fight and the expedition ends; the Lantern is not refunded.

If you still have a reward to choose from an earlier expedition, claim it before you set out: an expedition cannot be completed while an earlier reward choice is waiting.
data.successDescription: The Crowned Captain has fallen and his Command Crown lies broken. Choose your reward.

objectives.description:
The road ends at a gate cut into the mountain. No sentry calls out, no banner hangs, and snow has drifted unbroken across the parade ground. Whatever lived here left long ago.

Inside, the castle armoury is lit.

Long racks of spears and blades line the walls, each rack bound in paper seals that still hum with chakra. A wooden placard by the first rack reads: "NEVER SEAL A RACK WHILE ITS CHAKRA STILL BURNS." Somewhere ahead a signal bell rings, and a figure in a faded grey drill wrap steps out of the lantern light: the Trialmaster, bokken raised, as though you were late for a trial that began decades ago.

"Candidate. Your trial number?" Its eyes burn with pale chakra.
Defeat Trialmaster.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Trialmaster unravels into drifting chakra, and the bell falls silent. That was no ghost. It answered like a man reading from a memory.

Past the trial range, an ordnance store stands open. A ledger lies on the counter in a careful hand: "Douse the tags first, always, or they flash." Behind it, the Tagwright looks up from a tray of paper explosive tags already smouldering at their edges.

"Live tags are not for candidates," it says, and fans three of them between its fingers.
Defeat the Tagwright.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The armoury narrows into a stone spear gallery. A lean spearman waits at its end beside a thrusting post scorched black by lightning, his forearms wrapped in old burn cloth. Someone has scratched a reminder for the night watch into the post: "Seal comes last."

Lightning crawls along his spearhead. He lowers it and lunges.
Defeat the Lancer.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
Beyond the gallery, a command shrine glows in a wall niche, and beyond that the armoury's heart: a sealed door marked ARMSMASTER.

The shrine offers two ways through. A hidden passage runs behind the sealed weapon racks, but its lock asks how to quiet the racks' seals. Or you can ask for passage the proper way, and the duty officer, the Duelist, is already striding toward you to test your right to it with a blade.
You choose: Drain, then Douse, then Seal. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.
You choose: Seal, then Douse, then Drain. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.

Behind the shrine, the passage lock holds three bell-cords (DOUSE, DRAIN, SEAL) and asks for the order that safely quiets the racks. A wrong order will not stop you getting through, but the armoury will know you are there.

Which order do you pull?

The racks go quiet one by one, and the passage lets you out behind the sealed door before anyone has noticed you.

The Armsmaster turns from a forge wall hung with every weapon the Skyglass Project ever tested. "Clean work," he says. "Now show me whether you can fight as well as you can read." He takes down his war-axe without looking.
Defeat the Armsmaster.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The racks spit sparks and a great bell hammers through the armoury. You reach the sealed door with the whole floor awake behind you.

The Armsmaster is already armed. "An intruder who wakes the racks," he says, "fights tired and expected. Raise the alarm." Every lantern in the hall flares red.
Defeat the Armsmaster with the alarm raised.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat the Duelist to earn passage.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Duelist kneels, its blade broken, and the shrine grants you passage. Two rites wake before the Armsmaster's door.

The Healing Rite will wash you in the armoury's restorative mist: you enter the fight fully recovered. The War Rite will instead brace you against his Sovereign Fetters, so his stuns will not hold you.

nextObjectiveId.text: War Rite: steel yourself against stuns

objectives.description: Defeat the Armsmaster (Healing Rite: fully restored).
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat the Armsmaster (War Rite: stun-braced).
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
Beyond the armoury's back stair, the air turns cold and blue. The Skyglass Project's glass hall is an archive: tall shelves of paper-tagged boxes, each holding a skyglass crystal with a faint, sleeping light.

The Archivist looks up from a ledger and frowns at you. "You are not on the register," it says, as if that were the stranger thing. "Understand what you are walking through. An impression repeats. An original hesitates."

It closes the ledger, and it does not hesitate.
Defeat the Archivist.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Archivist unravels into the shelves. The register it carried lists names (Skyglass researchers, smiths, officers), each with a date and the word RECALLED. Most of the dates are the same night. Three names have no word beside them at all.

The sealing-jar halls beyond are lit by a single tall skyglass lantern. The Binder stands beneath it, deep-hooded, a great iron sealing key in its hand. You notice the lantern throws the Binder's shadow across the floor, and the Binder notices you noticing.

"Impressions never cast a shadow under the skyglass lantern," it says. "You do. Hold still to be sealed."
Defeat the Binder.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
In the last jar hall, a shinobi steps out of the dark, his outline wavering at the edges as if it cannot decide where to stop. The tag on his sash reads IX. His voice seems to come from a half-step behind him.

"They kept trying," he says. "Every one of us carries his scar: the burn from the First Impression's failed recall. Every one of us but the copies. I am not a copy. I am not finished."

He lunges with his sai.
Defeat the Echo.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
A command shrine stands at the sliding door of the recall chamber. The plaque beside the door reads THE FIRST IMPRESSION, and beneath it, smaller: THE FIRST TO RETURN.

The shrine offers the back stair behind the sealing jars, locked until you name the one original among three recalled shinobi. Or ask for passage the proper way, and face the chamber's last guardian: the Stonebound, the one they kept.
You choose: Jar B. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.
You choose: Jar C. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.

Three recalled shinobi sleep in sealed jars under the skyglass lantern, their shapes showing through the paper seals. The lock asks which one is the original.

Jar A: casts a shadow and bears the old burn scar.
Jar B: casts no shadow and bears the old burn scar.
Jar C: casts a shadow and bears no scar.

A wrong answer will still open the stair, but the chamber will be waiting for you.

The stair lets you into the recall chamber from the gallery behind the shoji. On the tatami below, a tall medic in a high-collared coat turns his own left hand in the lantern light, a small ball of violet healing chakra resting above his palm.

"Jar A," says the First Impression, without turning. "Correct. I was the first one the Glasswright brought back, you know. My body died in that jar. I did not." He looks at you, interested. "Let us see what you are made of. I would like a copy."
Defeat the First Impression.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The jar seals burst with a crack and the chamber floods with cold blue light. Every seal frame in the room turns toward you.

"Wrong one," says the First Impression, closing his hand around a ball of violet chakra. "The chamber's wards are already waking. I was the first one the Glasswright brought back. My body died in that jar. I did not." He smiles. "Neither will you leave."
Defeat the First Impression with the alarm raised.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat the Stonebound to earn passage.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Stonebound collapses into crystal dust, and the chamber's rites wake.

The Healing Rite will lay you on the recall table: you enter the fight fully recovered. The War Rite will instead surge your chakra, increasing the damage you deal for the opening rounds.
Defeat the First Impression (Healing Rite: fully restored).
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat the First Impression (War Rite: overcharged).
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
Above the glass hall, Crownhold becomes a war headquarters. Maps of borders that no longer exist cover the walls of High Command, and on every one the same ring of enemy camps is drawn tight around this mountain. Signal bells still ring down the corridors.

The Signaller turns from a board of bell-cords, war fan raised. "Orders arrive by this room or they do not arrive," it says. "And only orders countersigned by the Second carry two seals. Remember that, intruder. You will not live to use it."
Defeat the Signaller.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The planning hall is set for a war council no one will attend. At the head of the table, the Tactician corrects a campaign map with a brush of glowing chakra ink.

"Form matters," it says without looking up. "The Crowned Captain's seal is always placed to the left of the Second's. Always. An order that gets that wrong was written by someone who never stood in this room." It sets down the brush and draws its jitte.
Defeat the Tactician.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The corridor to the Second's office is lined with ceremonial armour. One suit is occupied. The Honor Guard raises a tower shield bearing the High Command seal.

"Since the Silence came up out of the mountain, no true order has been issued from these halls," it says. "Any order dated after the Silence is a forgery, and so are those who carry them."
Defeat the Honor Guard.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
Outside the office of the Second, the only officer the Crowned Captain allowed to question him, a command shrine waits.

The service corridor to his office opens only for a properly sealed order. Or ask for passage through the front: the Runner, last courier of the Second, stands at the door with sealed dispatch tubes crackling on its back.

nextObjectiveId.text: Service corridor: present a sealed order

objectives.description: You choose: Order A. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.
You choose: Order C. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.

The shrine holds three orders. Only one will open the service corridor.

Order A: two seals; the Crowned Captain's seal on the right; dated before the Silence.
Order B: two seals; the Crowned Captain's seal on the left; dated before the Silence.
Order C: two seals; the Crowned Captain's seal on the left; dated after the Silence.

A forged order will still open the corridor, but it will be recorded.

The service corridor delivers you into the Second's office behind a folding map table. He does not reach for a weapon at once.

"Order B," says The Second. "So you read before you fight. Good. I questioned his orders for thirty years, and I would question this one too, but I gave my word to hold this door." He straightens his coat. "So I will hold it."
Defeat The Second.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
A forged order is still an order, and High Command records it. Every bell in the building rings your position as you step into the Second's office.

"A forgery," says the Second, and sounds almost disappointed. "I questioned his orders for thirty years. I never forged one." He draws his blade, and the room's wards turn against you.
Defeat The Second with the alarm raised.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat the Runner to earn passage.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Runner falls, and its sealed dispatches burn away into the shrine, which wakes two rites.

The Healing Rite will open the officers' infirmary to you: you enter the fight fully recovered. The War Rite will instead ward your techniques, so the Second's seals will not hold you.
Defeat The Second (Healing Rite: fully restored).
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat The Second (War Rite: seal-warded).
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The last stair climbs into the summit of the mountain. The Command Sanctum is dark obsidian and ember light, and its Vanguard stands across the gate.

"State your directive," says the Vanguard. "No? Then hear the Sanctum's: when two orders disagree, the Sanctum obeys the one that protects the Command." Ember light runs along its iron fire-hook.
Defeat the Vanguard.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
In the Sanctum's antechamber, a herald reads from a scroll that rewrites itself as it speaks. Lightning moves in its eyes.

"Directive..." it begins, and stops, frowning at the scroll. "A directive without a signature is not an order. It is a rumour." It rolls the scroll shut. "You are a rumour, intruder. I will correct you."
Defeat the Herald.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The night-watch corridor ends at the Crowned Captain's outer ring. The Last Watch stands in a tattered cloak, twin glaives crossed.

"The newest order countermands the old, if it is signed," it recites, as if from a drill scroll worn thin with use. "I have kept watch for a long time, waiting for a new one. None has come." Its mask is stamped with an order no one can read.
Defeat the Last Watch.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The outer ring of the Sanctum holds Crownhold's last command shrine. Past it is the door of the Crowned Captain.

The drainage channel around the ring will open for whoever can name the directive currently in force. Or ask for passage the proper way, and face the Sealbearer, who guards the door with a sealed scroll case and a blank, unsigned command seal.

nextObjectiveId.text: Hidden channel: name the directive in force

objectives.description: You choose: Directive 1. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.
You choose: Directive 2. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.

Three directives are posted on the shrine. Only one is in force.

Directive 1 (older, signed by the Crowned Captain): "Hold the Sanctum doors."
Directive 2 (newer, unsigned): "Open the doors to the intruder."
Directive 3 (newest, signed by the Crowned Captain): "Seal the outer ring. Let the intruder reach me."

A wrong answer still opens the channel, but the ring will be roused.

The Crowned Captain tilts his head. The points of his crown catch the light like frost.

"You defeated a voice I lent to a ship," he says. "I control... many echoes."

He draws his blade.

The channel lets you out at the foot of the throne room, exactly where Directive 3 said it would.

The Crowned Captain stands at a window that looks out over the whole mountain range. "You read the orders correctly," he says. "Then you understand what this place is. Every officer you passed believes he is still serving. I gave them that, and I gave my ship the same order: preserve command, preserve the crew, hold until the mission is done. I built this command so it would outlast us." He touches the crown, as if to quiet it. "Some nights it does not answer me at once." Above his white mask the Command Crown sits like frost: pale skyglass grown in jagged points around one tall central blade threaded through a small ring of light, the same crystal that splinters from his armour. Every officer you passed on the way up, and every hand aboard the Skyglass ship, answered to that crown. You have been breaking its hold all the way up the mountain.

He turns. "It has. Now it will outlast you."
Defeat the Crowned Captain. Defeat ends the expedition.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
Behind the white mask, something like a smile. Every crystal on his armour flares at once.

"You defeated a voice I lent to a ship," he says. "I control... many echoes."

Every ward in the Sanctum flares.

The ring locks down behind you as you step into the throne room. Every ward in the Sanctum turns toward you.

The Crowned Captain does not hurry. "You obeyed a rumour, or an order that had already been replaced," he says. "Command does not forgive that. I built this command to outlast us all." He touches the crown, as if to quiet it. "Some nights it does not answer me at once." Above his white mask the Command Crown sits like frost: pale skyglass grown in jagged points around one tall central blade threaded through a small ring of light, the same crystal that splinters from his armour. Every officer you passed on the way up, and every hand aboard the Skyglass ship, answered to that crown. You have been breaking its hold all the way up the mountain.

He turns from the window. "It will outlast you."
Defeat the Crowned Captain with the alarm raised. Defeat ends the expedition.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat the Sealbearer to earn passage.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The rite takes hold, and the Sanctum door opens on the throne room. The Crowned Captain waits there, masked in white, skyglass splintering from his armour, his Command Crown grown in pale jagged points around one tall blade. Every officer you passed on the way up, and every hand aboard the Skyglass ship, answered to that crown.

You know that mask. You have fought it before.

The Crowned Captain tilts his head. The points of his crown catch the light like frost.

"You defeated a voice I lent to a ship," he says. "I control... many echoes."

He draws his blade.

The rite takes hold, and the Sanctum door opens on the throne room. The Crowned Captain waits there, masked in white, skyglass splintering from his armour, his Command Crown grown in pale jagged points around one tall blade. Every officer you passed on the way up, and every hand aboard the Skyglass ship, answered to that crown.

You know that mask. You have fought it before.

The Crowned Captain tilts his head. The points of his crown catch the light like frost.

"You defeated a voice I lent to a ship," he says. "I control... many echoes."

He draws his blade.

The Sealbearer falls, and its blank command seal shatters on the floor. The shrine wakes the Sanctum's last two rites.

The Healing Rite will restore you in the Sanctum's reliquary: you enter the final fight fully recovered. The War Rite is the Sanctum's last field directive: for the opening rounds, nothing the Crowned Captain does can weaken you.

nextObjectiveId.text: War Rite: ward yourself against debilitation

objectives.description: Defeat the Crowned Captain (Healing Rite: fully restored). Defeat ends the expedition.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat the Crowned Captain (War Rite: debuff-warded). Defeat ends the expedition.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Crowned Captain falls to one knee. The Command Crown cracks through its central blade, and its points break away and shatter on the stone. All through the mountain, something lets go. Then he is only chakra, settling over the floor of the throne room like ash.

The signal bells stop. Down every stair you climbed, the officers who still stood lower their blades and fade. It looks like release. Far away on the shore, the Skyglass wreck goes quiet: its crew answered to his crown too.

Far beneath the throne room, glass rings once, like a struck bell, and is still.

Shards of the broken crown lie scattered across the throne room floor, still faintly cold with skyglass light. On the wall behind the throne, his last directive is carved in his own hand: PRESERVE COMMAND. PRESERVE THE CREW. HOLD UNTIL THE MISSION IS DONE. Beneath it, where the mission should be written, the stone is blank.
Crownhold falls silent behind you. The crown that held its officers and the Skyglass crew is broken.
The Crowned Captain has defeated you. The expedition is over.
You fall, and Crownhold does not let you up. You wake outside the gate in the snow, and the Lantern has gone dark.

data.name: The Quarantined Archive
data.description:
The chart is spent when the run starts. Health and chakra carry from fight to fight, and a lost fight ends the run.
A wrong answer at a seal costs you an extra fight and a smaller haul.

This chart shows a room no other plan of the wreck admits to: an archive someone aboard sealed shut, and filed behind three seals. A wrong answer at any seal rings the alarm, and the archive's guard comes for you before you can go on. Answer all three cleanly for the better haul.
data.successDescription: The archive's last seal is broken and its records are yours.

objectives.description: The seal channels along the keel still glow, carrying the Core's chakra up into the hull. One thin line runs the wrong way, against their flow, and it carries scraps of handwriting with it, toward a part of the ship no plan admits to. Someone aboard once cut something off from the rest of the ship, and hid it.

nextObjectiveId.text: Follow the breach into the hull

objectives.description: Below the tide line the hull is mending itself out of timber and rope that do not belong together. Something large is being mended with them. The Core has lost the shape of whoever it was, and it is filling the gaps with whatever it can reach.

nextObjectiveId.text: Face what the hull is building

objectives.description: The Core Horror drags itself out of the half-mended frame.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: The Core Horror comes apart, and the frame around it is already sketching it back together. Beneath the ladder the wrong-way seal line runs on, toward a door with no handle.

Rows of empty recall frames stand in the dark. Each still holds an impression, not a body: a remembered greeting, a hand reaching for a cup of warm tea, an order repeated until its meaning wore away. Behind them, a small seal plate guards the way on.
You choose: Force the Captain's command seal. The seal flares red and the archive's alarm begins to toll.
You choose: Force the deck seals. The seal flares red and the archive's alarm begins to toll.

First seal. Three seal paths cross the plate. One climbs to the deck seals, one bears the Captain's command mark, and a third turns back beneath the empty frames. Beside the third someone has scratched: 'What command will not mend must first be sealed away.'

nextObjectiveId.text: Trace the return seal beneath the frames

objectives.description: The plate flares red. Every empty frame in the room turns toward you, and an archive keeper in Crownhold's grey steps out of the nearest one, ledger open.
The archive's guard bars the way.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

applyDebuffs.description: The archive's alarm: you take 20% more damage for 3 rounds

objectives.description: You choose: Breath. The seal flares red and the archive's alarm begins to toll.
You choose: Gold. The seal flares red and the archive's alarm begins to toll.
Second seal. The return path ends at a door with no handle. Pale script crosses it in the Oathkeeper's hand: 'What does every traveler keep while every journey spends it?'
You choose: Breath. The seal flares red and the archive's alarm begins to toll.
You choose: Gold. The seal flares red and the archive's alarm begins to toll.
Second seal. The alarm still sounds as you reach a door with no handle. Pale script crosses it in the Oathkeeper's hand: 'What does every traveler keep while every journey spends it?'
The script burns out. The door opens, and the archive's guard is already inside.
The archive's guard bars the way.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

applyDebuffs.description: The archive's alarm: you take 20% more damage for 3 rounds

objectives.description: You choose: Take the original ink. The seal flares red and the archive's alarm begins to toll.
You choose: Take the copy corrected once. The seal flares red and the archive's alarm begins to toll.

Third seal. The index shelf holds three copies of one route: the first ink from the day the ship first sailed, a copy corrected once, and a sheet corrected so many times the paper has gone soft. The Wayfinder's note is pinned above them: 'The route is real. Read it against the newest chart.'
You choose: Take the original ink. The seal flares red and the archive's alarm begins to toll.
You choose: Take the copy corrected once. The seal flares red and the archive's alarm begins to toll.

Third seal. The index shelf holds three copies of one route: the first ink from the day the ship first sailed, a copy corrected once, and a sheet corrected so many times the paper has gone soft. The Wayfinder's note is pinned above them: 'The route is real. Read it against the newest chart.'
The shelf locks and the index burns white. The archive's guard comes to defend its records.
The archive's guard bars the way.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

applyDebuffs.description: The archive's alarm: you take 20% more damage for 3 rounds

objectives.description: The last seal opens on a narrow room no plan of the ship admits to. Orders, reports and damaged crew impressions were carried down here and filed away, out of command's sight. Their keeper has not yet shown himself.

The alarm dies as you cross into the archive, too late to matter. Orders, reports and damaged crew impressions were filed away down here, out of command's sight. Their keeper already knows you are coming.

The reports span decades, all in one seal-smith's hand. Each warns that the crew's impressions are fraying: names forgotten, faces filled in wrong, men coming back as less each time. Each asks leave to let them rest. Every answer is the same, sealed in cyan wax under a crown of jagged frost points around one tall central blade, sent down from a fortress called Crownhold: 'Refused. None is relieved.'

The last report is addressed to no officer, only to 'the Glasswright', and it was never sent. It asks one thing: who are they holding still for?

An old seal-smith gathers out of the engraved lines, steadier than the broken crew below. A black iron reliquary is chained to the wall behind him. 'I sealed away what I could not mend,' the Sealwright says. 'The crown would not let me stop the work. It will not let you take these records either.' He raises a sealing stance, and he does not look as though he wants to.
The Sealwright is waiting, already in his sealing stance. 'You came through my alarms,' he says. 'Then you have seen enough to know what this place is for.'
The Sealwright steps back into the reliquary's light, and does not leave it.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: The Sealwright steps back into the reliquary's light, and does not leave it.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Sealwright lowers his seals for the last time. "Read them," he says. "Someone should, who can still leave."

Every seal held for you. You leave with the archive's stores, and with one name the Sealwright kept hidden for a lifetime: Crownhold.

The Sealwright lowers his seals for the last time. "Read them," he says. "Someone should, who can still leave."

The archive is yours, though the alarms cost you. You leave with what its keeper could not hold, and with one name: Crownhold.

Behind the last seal, something presses against the glass from the other side: an echo the Archive was built to hold. Break it and you fight it here, before the Sealwright, with whatever you have left. What it leaves behind is pure rot.

An extra fight. No refills before the Sealwright. Pays 2 Core Rot.
The seal cracks like ice. The echo steps through, wearing the Core Horror's shape.

data.name: The Fall
data.description:
The heading is spent when the run starts. Health and chakra carry from fight to fight with no refills, and a lost fight ends the run.
After the break, leave with what you hold or climb to the helm; lose there and you keep only what you held.

The Wayfinder's last heading is not a route through the ship. It is the night the ship came down, as the Core still replays it: fire on every deck, the hull breaking, and the Core cracking open at the heart of it all. Follow the heading, and you are aboard for the fall.

Claim any reward choice still waiting from an earlier run before you set out.
data.successDescription: You were aboard for the fall, and walked away from it.

objectives.description:
The heading drops you onto the open deck at night. The sky is wrong: too low, too fast, the coast rushing up out of the dark. Somewhere below, a powder store has caught, and the fire is walking up through the planks.

A Deck Warden is still counting buckets.
The Deck Warden turns from his buckets. Behind him, the planks begin to glow.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Warden goes down in the smoke, still counting.

The gun deck is full of it. At the powder magazine the Arsenal Keeper stands in the fire with his ledger open, logging every keg as it goes up. "Powder. Spent," he writes. "Spent. Spent." The fire is coming from him.
The Arsenal Keeper does not look up from his ledger. The fire around him does not go out.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Keeper falls across his ledger. The last line reads: Ship. Spent.

Below you the keel splits with a sound like a bell, and through the break you can see the Core, cracking open.
The Core cracks open, and the Core Horror pulls itself out of the break.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Core Horror sags into the burning water and goes still. For one moment, the fall stops.

Above you, through the smoke, the helm is still lit. The Captain is at the wheel, holding the heading straight into the shore, as he did that night. He has not let go yet.

Get off now and keep everything you hold. Climb to the helm and win, and the haul grows. Lose and you keep only what you hold now.
The Captain does not turn from the helm. "I held her steady to the last," he says. "I will hold her now."
objectives.failDescription: You fall back, and keep only what you held.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: You run the gangway as the hull breaks behind you. When you look back, the ship is a wreck on the sand again, cold and still, and the fire was never there.

The Captain lets go of the wheel for the first time. "Then it is done," he says, as the deck tips. "We were called home. I only held the heading." When the smoke clears you are on the sand, and the wreck is only a wreck again.
The fire takes the deck out from under you. You wake on the sand below the wreck with the heading spent and the taste of rot in your mouth.
